description: Full block-tile shape sweep for inference (d=64, bf16, hstu). Sweeps sequence<kM0,kN0,kN0Sub,kN1,kK1,MaxK>: M=km0 {64,128,192}, N=kn0 {32,64,128}, K-stream=kn0sub+kk1 (must be equal; sweep kk1 {16,32,64}, kn0sub auto-matched in instance_gen gate), V head tile kn1 {16,32,64}, warp_k {16,32}. Invalid combos skipped by instance_gen (kN0Sub==kK1, divisibility, spill). Kernel names get _km0NNN _n0NNN _n0sNNN _n1NNN _k1NNN tokens when overridden. splitkv/pingpong off to isolate tile shape. Use --problem-index 5.
